_comment: Official sources behind the compliance skills in docs/ai/secure-compliance/. Each source records the version the skills are written against (tracked_version) and the skills that depend on it (skills); docs/ai/sync-ai-wrappers.py --check fails if a standard-* skill has no source here, and copies these fields into each skill and the README. The 'Compliance sources review' workflow (.github/workflows/compliance-sources-review.yml) checks every source on the 1st and 16th of each month and opens an issue. After reviewing a change, update the affected skills, tracked_version, last_seen_sha and last_reviewed here in one PR.
